user.title: Hive Local TRV
user.description: Enter your Zigbee2MQTT base topic. TRVs are discovered automatically.

data_description.z2m_base_topic: Must match base_topic in your Zigbee2MQTT configuration (default: zigbee2mqtt)

abort.already_configured: This Zigbee2MQTT instance is already configured.
abort.no_devices_available: All discovered TRVs are already assigned to room groups.

data_description.boiler_entity: Turned on or off based on TRV heat demand. Supports climate, switch, and input_boolean.
data_description.person_entities: When all selected people leave home, frost protection activates automatically.
data_description.enable_diagnostics: Writes HIVE_DIAG entries to the HA log. Useful for troubleshooting — disable once working.

add_room.title: Add Room Group — Step 1 of 3
add_room.description: Give the room a name. You will pick which TRVs belong to it in the next step.

data_description.room_name: Display name for this room group, e.g. Living Room or Master Bedroom.

add_room_trvs.title: Add Room Group — Step 2 of 3
add_room_trvs.description:
Select the TRVs and thermostats for room: {room_name}

Only devices not already in another group are shown.

data_description.trv_names: Select one or more TRVs or thermostats. Each device can only belong to one group.

add_room_sensors.title: Add Room Group — Step 3 of 3
add_room_sensors.description:
Room: {room_name} with {trv_count} device(s): {trv_names}

Optionally add extra temperature sensors to improve the room average.

data_description.temp_sensors: Additional HA temperature sensor entities included alongside TRV readings in the room temperature average.

remove_room.title: Remove Room Group
remove_room.description: Select the room group to remove. Individual TRV entities are not affected.
